snippet.title: Egypt Frontiers I Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Can you build faster than the Pharaohs?

You’ve seen people build houses… now build pyramids!
🎮 Egypt Frontiers is out in Early Access!
👷‍♂️ Build your own monuments, explore the desert, and create history — one brick at a time.

🏺 Available now on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2402630/Egypt_Frontiers/


#egyptfrontiers #pcgaming #indiegame
